statements.text: A sundial uses the changing position of a shadow cast in sunlight.
An hourglass uses sand flowing from one bulb to the other.
A candle clock uses only the flame getting dimmer to mark elapsed time.

stem:
Myra compares a sundial, an hourglass, and a candle clock.

Which statements correctly match a device to the observable change it uses to mark time?

teacher.key_rationale: A sundial tracks a Sun-cast shadow; an hourglass tracks sand flow. A candle clock uses marked burning of the candle, not merely a dimmer flame.
